requester.say: This is your Alerts page. When you send a request or claim, a “Sent” note appears here saying who has it. If it waits two working days, a “Still waiting” note tells you we have reminded them.

stock_manager.say: This is your Alerts page. Reminders about requests waiting for you appear here on weekday mornings, counted in working days.
